title: The Small Patch Behind the Story House
synopsis: Amy discovers a small sunny patch behind Story House; Grandma May asks permission to use it as a garden, and Amy adds its location to her real map.
continuity_state: Before: Season four complete. Button Town drawing and props sit in the brown envelope beside the blue Book of Little Sounds at Story House; the real orchard map is accurate. No Story House garden exists yet. After: Amy and Grandma May notice a stone-bordered patch behind the sunny southern Story House wall. Grandma checks with other caretakers and obtains permission to garden without blocking the path. Amy adds a tiny square behind Story House on her real yellow map; the patch has no seeds yet. A fallen leaf sits on the border; old clay pot nearby.
